name: Typeform
description: Typeform is an online form and survey platform for building conversational questionnaires, registrations, quizzes, feedback flows, and lead-capture experiences. Teams use it to publish branded forms, organize work in shared workspaces, and collect structured responses across web and embedded experiences.
agentUseSummary: Connect one Typeform account, workspace, and validated API region through Relay-owned OAuth, then let agents read approval-gated, bounded Form metadata and completed Response lifecycle timestamps without exposing questions, answers, respondent identity, or hidden data.

capabilities.label: Read forms and response lifecycle
capabilities.description: Read bounded Form metadata and completed Response lifecycle timestamps for one exact Typeform account, workspace, and API region.

approvalRequired.label: List workspace forms
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty-five Typeform Form summaries from the selected workspace, newest update first.

approvalRequired.label: Read a form summary
approvalRequired.description: Read one exact Typeform Form summary without questions, fields, choices, logic, media, variables or tracking.

approvalRequired.label: List recent response lifecycle
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty-five completed Response lifecycle summaries submitted during the previous fourteen days.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Every bounded Typeform read requires approval; questions, answers, respondent identity, hidden values, metadata, files, payments, webhooks, export and writes are outside Relay's V1 surface.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The three selected bounded Typeform reads run without Relay per-action approval; account/workspace/region binding, redaction, first-page bounds, audits, scopes, refresh rotation and rate limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts three typed Typeform read wrappers and attaches the encrypted OAuth token only to the validated global or EU API origin.
Relay mounts three typed Typeform read wrappers and attaches the encrypted OAuth token only to the validated global or EU API origin.

providerSetup.blocker: A Relay-owned Typeform Developer App, one-time client-secret capture, staging credentials, eligible global/EU test accounts, and live consent validation still require the separate provider-console task.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task, register the Typeform app with Relay's exact HTTPS callback and exact five scopes, capture the client secret once into staging, then verify account/workspace/API-region binding, provider-authoritative access expiry, single-use refresh-token replacement, all three bounded reads, two-requests-per-second enforcement, local disconnect, and post-disconnect denial. Do not request write, image, theme, or webhook scopes or claim undocumented upstream revocation.

evidence.supports: Typeform documents the authorization and token endpoints, exact callback and state, confidential client credentials, provider expires_in, offline refresh, newly returned single-use refresh tokens, and default one-week access lifetime.
Typeform documents the accounts:read, workspaces:read, forms:read, responses:read, and offline scopes used by Relay's bounded read-only contract.
Typeform documents global and EU data-center API origins while keeping OAuth authorization on the fixed global endpoint.
Typeform documents token-visible Workspace enumeration used to bind one exact selected workspace.
Typeform documents selected-workspace Form listing, page size, page, last-update sort, and order parameters used by the fixed bounded wrapper.
Typeform documents exact Form retrieval; Relay retains only identifier, title, language, public flag, lifecycle timestamps, and selected workspace.
Typeform documents completed Response filtering, date bounds, page size, submitted order, lifecycle timestamps, pagination, and provider freshness behavior.
